name: Snake River — Wilson to South Park and Astoria (Jackson Hole)
gaugeName: Snake River Below Flat Creek, Near Jackson, WY (USGS 13018750)
blurb: Snake River from Wilson to South Park and Astoria through Jackson Hole; Wyoming Game and Fish access sites.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: Put-in Wilson (Snake): exact agency facility pin. Take-out South Park/Von Gontard Landing (Snake): exact agency facility pin. WGFD PAA 'Von Gontard Landing' (South Park launch): access dates March 1 - November 30. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (12.8 mi); no agency mileage found.

Put-in South Park/Von Gontard Landing (Snake): exact agency facility pin. Take-out Astoria (Snake): approximate area only. Bridger-Teton NF Snake River Special Recreation Permit area: within ¼ mile of each bank from the Hoback River confluence to 1 mile above the Alpine Junction Bridge. Bridger-Teton NF Snake River Canyon: "special use permits for non-commercial groups over 15 people and for institutional outfitters are required" (South Park Bridge to Sheep Gulch); launch at the existing ramps. WGFD PAA 'Von Gontard Landing' (South Park launch): access dates March 1 - November 30. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal.
